name: sol10-status-capture-state
goal: Capture each shared Status state only after its interaction and visible open-state marker.

evidence: Commit 0ef7333339 added shared Status to the early capture list. The f6 API record c19fff7c has open-state images identical to closed states because capture precedes click/focus. Product behavior is correct; fixture ordering is wrong.

Later DOM assertions checked the opened state but never tied it to saved pixels. Extend the existing capture readiness helper and existing catalog case to require visible open markers and the post-action capture object; keep all 72 cases.
Formal red 8cb327bbfaa10ecb5ad861f4951d315347f7f9cc920695363242c6d0694e39d7 at this exact 2b51961f13 commit fails the entered-state readiness assertion for passed-open at desktop, tablet and mobile.
Remove Status from the early capture list so its existing click/focus preparation finishes before the normal screenshot. Retain the shared entered-state and capture-object guards unchanged.
Status uses the normal post-interaction capture path. The capture-time open marker and post-action evidence-object assertions remain unchanged, so reintroducing the early list entry is rejected.
